stories.title: From night life in Egypt to rice farming in Vietnam, the war in Iran is a drain
stories.summary: Fuel costs more. Food is harder to get. Jobs are evaporating. And in Cairo, cafes and restaurants are ordered to close at 9 p.m.

stories.title: Vessels seized by the U.S. this week were part of a global 'shadow fleet'
stories.summary: NPR's Juana Summers speaks with Elisabeth Braw, senior fellow at the Atlantic Council, about shadow vessels, after the U.S. military's seizure of two Iranian-linked oil tankers.

stories.title: Workers in Arizona don't have protections they need from triple-digit temperatures
stories.summary: Labor groups say Arizona isn't moving fast enough to establish new protections for people whose work exposes them to the state's sizzling high temperatures.

stories.title: Europe pushes back on reported U.S. plans to punish NATO allies
stories.summary: U.S. allies are pushing back after leaked email reveals Washington's frustration over their lack of support for the Iran war — and plans for retaliation.

stories.title: Noah Kahan pays homage to his hometown on 'The Great Divide'
stories.summary: Vermonter Noah Kahan reflects on his New England roots as he rises to stardom with new album The Great Divide. NPR's Scott Detrow speaks with Vermont Public's DJ Llu about the record.

stories.title: For Nikki Glaser, joking about thorny subjects is a practiced skill
stories.summary: NPR's Ailsa Chang talks with Nikki Glaser about her new comedy special on Hulu, Good Girl.
